decisions.problem: Comparison with weak baseline could exaggerate usefulness
decisions.decision: Use strongest persisted pair, exact saved splits, reproduce metrics before reporting

decisions.problem: Feature universality was interpreted too narrowly
decisions.decision: Agent may choose semantic task-specific hypotheses; retain generic executors and no hardcoded task router

decisions.problem: Context features improved development but worsened reused audit
decisions.decision: Do not promote; retain 39.03614722027966 regression reference

decisions.problem: Finite budgets cannot enumerate every parameter combination
decisions.decision: Cover distinct error mechanisms; record tested and untested approaches rather than claim global optimum

decisions.problem: Temporal validation errors concentrate when an informative input is missing
decisions.decision: Consider more flexible leaf models and explicit missingness; do not remove difficult rows

decisions.problem: Native CatBoost and DART need substantially more CPU than a small pilot
decisions.decision: Retain explicit worker deadlines, fixed iterations for DART, and measured cost in report

decisions.problem: Macro F1 may be limited by a few conditional class confusions
decisions.decision: Fit at most three pair specialists chosen on calibration; preserve total probability mass and evaluate on a different selection population

decisions.problem: Search-early-stopped cached regression predictions were compared with fixed new recipes
decisions.decision: Preserve earlier evidence; use a separately frozen fair comparison and genuine fixed-round OOF for meta-training
decisions.status: corrected; negative audit of newly selected deeper model retained

decisions.problem: Systematic category residuals may remain after strong boosting
decisions.decision: Use only strictly earlier out-of-fit residuals; choose shrinkage policy on later development origins before audit

decisions.problem: Final refit legitimately expands training scope
decisions.decision: Freeze method first; include former control labels only through honest forecasts at final fit; never rescore that final calibrator on former control

decisions.problem: One development improvement is not official contest quality
decisions.decision: Retain canonical submissions and all negative studies; publish a separate candidate and explicit limits
